== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Field Dressing]] (GEMP <code>2271_2038</code>), showing the '''reconstructed original''' game text. Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text (no copy of the first printing, 18 June 2010, is known); the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-03-Field_Dressing.png]]) prints PC-E2 and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-fielddressing-pre.gif]]) PC-E3.

* '''Text source:''' reconstructed (Bill, 10 November 2026) from the PC-E1 errata text of the Players Committee news post “Pre-Worlds 2010 errata changes” (23 July 2010; [https://web.archive.org/web/20100820023348/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=255:pre-worlds-2010-errata-changes&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Internet Archive]) without “and, if 'hit,' is restored to normal”; the post explains the errata but does not quote the old text.
* '''Reconstructed text:''' “If you just forfeited a character of ability < 5 present at a site, deploy on that character (who remains at same site). Character is forfeit = 0 (even if forfeit may not normally be reduced). May play First Aid to place this card in Used Pile. Immune to your Control.”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, STANDARD rev 73) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1271_38</code>: Decipher art of Heroic Sacrifice, title ••Field Dressing, lore, Special Edition sphere, Virtual Block 7 set mark), without the errata mark E. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
